feedback.problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}2 & 6 & 11 & 0 \\ 2 & -4 & -5 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 6 & 9 \\ 0 & 2 & 9 & 8\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}2 & 0 & -7 & -27 \\ 2 & 0 & 7 & 18 \\ 0 & 2 & 6 & 9 \\ 0 & 0 & 3 & -1\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the matrices $A$ and $B$ above. By applying three matrix elementary row operations 

- ${R}_{1}:=…$
- ${R}_{2}:=…$
- ${R}_{4}:={R}_{4}-{R}_{3}$

each of the form ${R}_{i}:={R}_{i}+k{R}_{3},$ the matrix $A$ can be transformed into the matrix $B.$ What are the missing elementary row operations?
feedback.worked_solution:
To transform $A$ into $B,$ we need to make entries above and below ${a}_{32}=2$ equal to $0.$

To do this, we can apply the following elementary row operations:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}2 & 6 & 11 & 0 \\ 2 & -4 & -5 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 6 & 9 \\ 0 & 2 & 9 & 8\end{aligned}] &  & \,\begin{aligned}{R}_{1}:={R}_{1}-3{R}_{3}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}2 & 0 & -7 & -27 \\ 2 & -4 & -5 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 6 & 9 \\ 0 & 2 & 9 & 8\end{aligned}] &  & \,\begin{aligned}{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+2{R}_{3}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}2 & 0 & -7 & -27 \\ 2 & 0 & 7 & 18 \\ 0 & 2 & 6 & 9 \\ 0 & 2 & 9 & 8\end{aligned}] &  & \,\begin{aligned}{R}_{4}:={R}_{4}-{R}_{3}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}2 & 0 & -7 & -27 \\ 2 & 0 & 7 & 18 \\ 0 & 2 & 6 & 9 \\ 0 & 0 & 3 & -1\end{aligned}] \\  & =B.\end{aligned}
$$

  

Therefore, the missing elementary row operations are

$\,$ ${R}_{1}:={R}_{1}-3{R}_{3}\,$ and $\,{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+2{R}_{3}.$
